description:
EXPERIMENTAL — List available company registries and supported jurisdictions.

Returns the list of company registries that can be searched,
along with the jurisdiction codes you can use in
company_search_person and company_search_company. This is the LIVE
list and outranks the codes named in those two tools' descriptions.

Any country code not returned here has no registry behind it: a search
naming it comes back empty and "completed", which does not mean the
company is unregistered. `XX` (GLEIF LEI) is global and is the fallback
for those jurisdictions.

No API key required.

Examples:
  company_registries()
name: company_registries
